description: Accessiboss issues found by automated checks on one site. action list (default; optional state open/fixed/dismissed, kind failure/bad_practice/needs_review, severity, limit, offset), export (the same filters plus pageUrl; format csv or html, the html is a clean page to print or save as PDF; locale fi/sv/en for the plain language texts; Scale and Agency plans only, enforced on the server) or set_state (issueId + state open/fixed/dismissed, optional reason; confirm), groups (the same problem repeated across pages counted as one group per check, kind and severity, biggest first: issue, page and element counts, the top elements with the pages they are on and one example issue id, templateElement when one shared element causes them all, and the plain language title, why and fix in locale fi/sv/en; state defaults to open; filters state, kind, severity, pageUrl, limit up to 200, offset; totalGroups and totalIssues are the true totals) or set_group_state (ruleId + kind from groups, state open/fixed/dismissed, optional severity, selector for one element only, pageUrl for one page only, reason; fixed or dismissed changes every open issue of the group, open brings the group back; one statement; confirm). needs_review means a person has to look. Automated checks cover only part of WCAG.

action.description: list is default. groups counts the same problem across pages as one group. set_state and set_group_state need confirm. export returns the filtered issues as CSV or printable HTML (Scale and Agency plans).

format.description: export: csv (default) or html, a clean page to print or save as PDF.

issueId.description: set_state: issue id from action list.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

locale.description: export and groups: language of the plain language texts (default en).

pageUrl.description: export and groups: only issues on this exact page address; set_group_state: change the group on this page only.

ruleId.description: set_group_state: the check id of the group from action groups.

selector.description: set_group_state: only this element of the group (a selector from topElements).

site.description: Accessiboss site: id, public key or domain. Optional when the account has one site.

state.description: list, groups and export filter (groups defaults to open); set_state and set_group_state: the new state.

name: oma_accessiboss_issues
title: Accessiboss issues
